description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - SLFRS 17 - Insurance Contracts
reasoning: This gazette content publishes the Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standard 17 (Insurance Contracts) under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, establishing principles for recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure of insurance contracts. This constitutes regulatory/legal framework establishment for financial reporting standards, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for accounting practices.
